metadata.system_name: Generate me a bus resevation system design

system_overview.problem_statement: Generate me a bus resevation system design
system_overview.architecture_pattern: Modular Cloud Microservices with Reactive Event-Driven Ingestion & Distributed Cache

clarified_specifications.Q-SCALE-01: Campus Scale (10,000+ daily active users, 500 requests/sec peak)
clarified_specifications.Q-DATA-02: Strict ACID Transactions (PostgreSQL with Serializable Isolation & Redis Redlock)
clarified_specifications.Q-AUTH-03: LDAP / Active Directory Integration with SAML 2.0

functional_requirements.title: Tenants Authentication & Authorization
functional_requirements.description: Secure sign-up, sign-in, token refresh, and role-based access control (RBAC) supporting Tenants, Platform Admins, API Clients, Background Workers.

functional_requirements.title: TenantAccount Core Management & Lifecycle
functional_requirements.description: Full CRUD capabilities, validation constraints, and transactional consistency for TenantAccount and CoreResource.

functional_requirements.title: Real-Time Telemetry & Event Synchronization
functional_requirements.description: High-frequency event broadcasting and state updates powered by Event-driven asynchronous queues (BullMQ/Redis) + WebSocket notifications.

functional_requirements.title: Audit Logging, Metrics & Administrative Insights
functional_requirements.description: Structured operational telemetry, immutable audit trails, and compliance monitoring adhering to SOC2 Type II, TLS 1.3 end-to-end encryption, and Row-Level Security (RLS).

non_functional_requirements.latency: P95 API response time < 80ms; in-memory cache lookups < 5ms (enterprise multi-tenant scale (P95 latency < 80ms, 10,000+ QPS))
non_functional_requirements.scalability: Horizontal pod auto-scaling (HPA) driven by CPU and request throughput metrics
non_functional_requirements.security: TLS 1.3 in-transit, AES-256 at-rest, Row-Level Security (RLS), and SOC2 Type II, TLS 1.3 end-to-end encryption, and Row-Level Security (RLS)
non_functional_requirements.data_integrity: ACID guarantees for transactional operations with distributed locking

domain_entities.description: Primary domain entity managing TenantAccount lifecycle and state in Distributed Multi-Tenant Cloud Architecture.
Primary domain entity managing CoreResource lifecycle and state in Distributed Multi-Tenant Cloud Architecture.
Primary domain entity managing WorkflowTask lifecycle and state in Distributed Multi-Tenant Cloud Architecture.
Primary domain entity managing AuditLog lifecycle and state in Distributed Multi-Tenant Cloud Architecture.

constraints_and_assumptions: Containerized microservice architecture using Docker and Kubernetes orchestration
Stateless compute layer enabling seamless rolling deployments and horizontal scaling
Strict separation of concerns across Frontend Presentation, API Ingress, Domain Services, and Persistence Layers
Mandatory compliance with SOC2 Type II, TLS 1.3 end-to-end encryption, and Row-Level Security (RLS)

hld.executive_summary: Enable students to search, borrow, and return books through a web application is designed as an enterprise-grade Modular Layered Microservices architecture for Education & Library Management. The system isolates core domain workflows into resilient, independently deployable services backed by PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7.2 Cluster.
business_goals: Achieve 99.9% system availability for Education & Library Management operations.
Ensure sub-250ms p95 response time under concurrent user load.
Enforce strict transaction consistency and data auditability.

major_services.name: Authentication & Role Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for authentication & role service.

major_services.name: Catalog & Search Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for catalog & search service.

major_services.name: Circulation & Borrowing Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for circulation & borrowing service.

major_services.name: Notification & Reminder Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for notification & reminder service.

major_services.name: Inventory & Asset Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for inventory & asset service.

major_services.name: Reporting & Analytics Service
major_services.responsibility: Handles core domain transactions and workflows for reporting & analytics service.

communication_patterns.usage: Client-to-Gateway and Gateway-to-Core Service request-response APIs
Domain event notification reminders, transaction history audits, and background tasks
communication_patterns.resilience: Dead-letter exchange with exponential retry backoff (3 attempts)

data_strategy.replication: Primary-Replica configuration with automated failover and read-replica offloading
data_strategy.backup_policy: Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) with continuous WAL archiving and daily full snapshots

security_overview.authentication: Stateless JWT access tokens with Redis-backed refresh token rotation
security_overview.authorization: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced at API Gateway and Service boundary
security_overview.data_protection: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 encryption in transit
security_overview.audit_logging: Immutable audit log trail for all administrative and modification transactions

deployment_strategy.ingress: Ingress-NGINX with TLS Termination and Rate Limiting
deployment_strategy.ci_cd: GitHub Actions automated build, container vulnerability scan, and rolling deployment
deployment_strategy.monitoring: Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing

backend.reasoning: Asynchronous high-performance framework with native OpenAPI schema generation and typed Pydantic data validation.

frontend.reasoning: Component modularity, server-side rendering for catalog search performance, and rich ecosystem.

database.reasoning: ACID compliance for critical domain workflows, row-level locking for transactional state concurrency, and JSONB support.

cache.reasoning: High-throughput in-memory caching for low-latency search queries and distributed session state.

authentication.selected_option: OAuth2 with Authorization Code Flow & PKCE (JWT RS256)
authentication.reasoning: Stateless token authorization, fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC), and zero plain-text token exposure.

cloud.reasoning: Serverless container orchestration eliminating OS management overhead with automated Multi-AZ database backups.

api_endpoints.description: Authenticate user or staff and issue JWT tokens
Search books across catalog with pagination and query filters
Executes borrow checkout transaction with row-level locking
Executes book check-in and updates loan status
Librarian administrative endpoint to add or retire catalog books
Validates role permissions and refresh token rotations

services.name: Authentication & Role Service
services.responsibility: Handles identity, token issuance, and RBAC permission guards.

services.name: Catalog & Search Service
services.responsibility: Manages catalog indexing, text queries, and book availability caching.

services.name: Circulation & Borrowing Service
services.responsibility: Coordinates checkout and return lifecycles using distributed ACID transactions.

services.name: Notification & Reminder Service
services.responsibility: Dispatches automated reminders for due dates and overdue fines.

services.name: Inventory & Asset Service
services.responsibility: Tracks physical book copies, shelf barcode tags, and asset condition.

services.name: Reporting & Analytics Service
services.responsibility: Generates circulation metrics, overdue aggregations, and usage BI dashboards.

state_management.form_state: React Hook Form + Zod schema validation

Library book catalog master records and availability status

indexes.purpose: Fast unique email lookups for authentication
Filter catalog books by owner and status

migrations_strategy.deployment: Automated migration execution via GitHub Actions pre-deployment hook per microservice schema

performance_tuning.connection_pool_size: 20 min, 50 max via PgBouncer transaction pooling with SQLAlchemy asyncpg driver
performance_tuning.concurrency_control: Read Committed isolation with explicit row-level locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE) on books.status during borrow/return

compute.instance_specs: 0.5 vCPU, 1 GB RAM per Fargate task replica per microservice (6 services)
compute.base_os: Alpine-based multi-stage Docker container images (Python 3.12 slim runtime)

networking.vpc_topology: Custom VPC with Public subnets (ALB + NAT Gateway) and Private subnets (ECS Fargate tasks + RDS + ElastiCache) across 2 Availability Zones
networking.dns_ssl: AWS Route 53 public hosted zone with ACM-issued TLS 1.3 certificates terminated at ALB
networking.api_gateway: AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB) with path-based routing, WAF association, and rate limiting at 100 RPS per client IP

storage.database: AWS RDS for PostgreSQL 16 (db.t4g.medium, Multi-AZ, 100 GB gp3 storage, automated daily snapshots with 7-day retention and PITR)
storage.cache: AWS ElastiCache for Redis 7.2 (cache.t4g.small, 2-node cluster mode disabled, Multi-AZ replication group)
storage.static_assets: AWS S3 bucket (private, versioned) fronted by CloudFront CDN for frontend Next.js assets and user-uploaded media

container_orchestration.ecs_task_definitions: 6 separate ECS services (svc-auth, svc-catalog, svc-circulation, svc-notification, svc-inventory, svc-reporting) each backed by its own ECR image and its own PostgreSQL schema (authentication_db, catalog_db, circulation_db, notification_db, inventory_db, reporting_db)
container_orchestration.health_checks: ECS container health checks on /live (every 15s) and /ready (every 30s) endpoints; ALB target group health checks with 3 failure threshold, deregistration delay 30s

stages: Lint (ruff/mypy) and Pytest unit + integration tests
Docker multi-stage build and Trivy vulnerability scan
Push image to Amazon ECR (immutable tags per commit SHA)
Run Alembic database migrations against RDS
ECS rolling deployment with circuit breaker enabled

monitoring.metrics: AWS CloudWatch Container Insights (CPU, memory, network), ALB request metrics, RDS Performance Insights, custom CloudWatch metrics for JWT auth failures and RabbitMQ queue depth
monitoring.alerting: SNS alerts on task CPU > 80% for 5 min, 5xx error rate > 1%, RDS connections > 80% of max, and DLQ message count > 0

scaling_strategy.auto_scaling: ECS Service Auto Scaling with target tracking on 70% average CPU and on ALB request count per target (>1000 requests/target)

authentication.protocol: OAuth2 with Authorization Code Flow & PKCE
authentication.token_expiry: 15 minutes Access Token, 7 days Refresh Token with Rotation
authentication.session_store: Redis 7.2 Cluster with Blacklist Token Revocation

network_security.ingress_waf: AWS WAF with OWASP Top 10 rule group and rate-limiting (100 RPS per IP)
network_security.tls_version: TLS 1.3 Strict HTTPS Enforcement via Route 53 + ACM
network_security.cors_policy: Restricted origin domain whitelist with credentials enabled

data_protection.at_rest: AES-256 AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys for RDS PostgreSQL and S3 Buckets
data_protection.in_transit: TLS 1.3 end-to-end between Client, ALB, and ECS Fargate microservices

audit_logging.trail: Immutable append-only audit trail for all checkout, fine, and role change events
audit_logging.retention: 3 years in encrypted CloudWatch Logs with S3 Glacier archiving
